settings.heading: Use & care
settings.content: Fasten the wrap over your knee, elbow or shoulder, press the button to choose 45°C, 50°C or 65°C, and add one of the three massage settings if you like. Sessions of around 15–20 minutes work well for most people. Use over light clothing if you prefer a gentler warmth, and top up the 4000mAh battery by USB between uses. As with any heat product, don't sleep while wearing it, and check with your GP first if you have a health condition.

settings.heading: Will it fit me? (measurements)
settings.content:
The wrap fastens with two adjustable straps: a 68cm (26.8") long strap and a 30cm (11.8") short strap, plus an extension strap included in the box that adds extra length for shoulders or larger legs.

To check your fit: run a tape measure around your leg just above the knee. Under 68cm (26.8") and the standard strap fits comfortably. Larger than that, or fitting it to a shoulder? Message us your measurement and we'll confirm before you order.
